target_customer: Marketing teams at B2B and ecommerce companies needing privacy-compliant attribution
problem: GDPR, CCPA, iOS 14 changes and the planned end of third-party cookies broke traditional marketing attribution.

founders.name: Colin Snyder
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as the only founder and does not give a bio.

competitors.name: Triple Whale
competitors.what: Shopify-focused attribution with a first-party pixel, built in response to iOS 14

competitors.name: Northbeam
competitors.what: Marketing attribution using machine learning and media mix modeling without cookies

technical_complexity.rationale: Probabilistic attribution without personal data requires modeling and tracking infrastructure, but this was a known problem with several vendors.

defensibility.rationale: Many funded attribution vendors addressed the same cookie-loss problem and the approach was easy to copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Competitors flourished; no evidence Banabo reached scale.

market_need_then: Privacy regulation and iOS 14 reduced tracking accuracy, creating demand for cookieless attribution, per the company description.

branding.domain_note: banabo.io now redirects to strinkl.com, a different content analytics product operated by Anita Labs, Inc.; the relation is not stated.

identity.voice_and_tone: Mission: get marketing waste to zero

brand_strength.rationale: No brand press found and the domain now redirects elsewhere.

outcome_analysis: Banabo was a two person attribution startup in YC Summer 2022. Its domain now redirects to a different product, strinkl.com, and no funding, customers or news were found, so the outcome is unclear. The directory still lists it as Active, but the sources cannot show whether it continued, pivoted or stopped, so no failure factors are asserted.
notes: Aggregators disagree: Extruct lists a $125K pre-seed and CB Insights and VCBacked list $500K total in August 2022, with Y Combinator and Soma Capital as investors; all aggregators, so not recorded as rounds. CB Insights lists Daniel Reilly as founder while YC lists Colin Snyder, unresolved. Competitor sources are undated 2026 vendor comparisons, so traction then is unknown. Searches for a pivot, rebrand or shutdown returned nothing relevant. Singapore location from the directory is not supported; sources place HQ in San Francisco. Completeness pass: Rounds rest on single databases and conflict (Extruct pre-seed $125K 2022-08-22; CB Insights convertible note $500K 2022-09-07, VCBacked total $500K Aug 2022); amounts not summed and they may be the same raise.
